I've been a crossfitter for almost 5 years now, but in my job I have to travel a lot. Going to local boxes at $20 a shot gets really old, and most hotel gyms are terrible. So, I have tended to make my own WODs up.

A while back I found Darebee, and started using them for workout ideas. I'm not much into punching air, but most of the other things they have in their workouts are pretty good, particularly for endurance.

Curious to see what the rest of you think.

Crossfit style workouts aren't very productive. They try to be strength training and cardio at the same time, but really they fail at both. I'd recommend checking out the beginner routine for some solid bodyweight strength training that you can do in half an hour, three days per week. And then if you want to do cardio too, either do the included burnout HIIT cardio, or if you want to do steady state cardio, find a place to either row or swim, as those burn the most calories for the amount of effort you put in.

The workouts are pretty retarded. I mean, even for circuit training, they're bad. Some of the other stuff is cool though, like the kick master challenge and the splits in 30 days program, I'd do those.
